title: Singed Letter
wikitext:
The '''Singed Letter''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Horde|1|Singed Letter (quest)|Singed Letter|race=Goblin|class=warlock}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
<name>, the shadows have a certain allure, don't they? I've seen you flinging bolts left and right and you seem to be a promising individual!

In this world, the unassuming are the ones with the most advantages. Use that, and power and gold will be in your lap faster than you can blink. Show me how eager you are to learn more about what a warlock is capable of by paying me and in turn I'll instruct you in the arts of demonology.

Amri Demondeal, Warlock Trainer.
}}
